definition_en: extremely important because everything else depends on it
core_image: 一座窄桥只容一人通过，桥下是深谷
scene: 队伍走到一座窄桥前，桥下是深谷。One wrong step would be crucial for the whole climb.
sceneCN: 这里 crucial 指「至关重要的」（第 1 个义项：整个结果都取决于它的）；句意是走错一步，对整次攀登都至关重要。

senses.title: Extremely important
senses.definition: so important that the whole outcome depends on it
senses.definitionCN: 重要到整个结果都取决于它
senses.example: Sleep is crucial for memory.
senses.exampleCN: 睡眠对记忆至关重要。
senses.why: One thing can hold up everything that comes after it.
senses.whyCN: 一样东西，就能撑住它之后的全部。

senses.title: Decisive at a turning point
senses.definition: settling the result at one particular moment
senses.definitionCN: 在某个特定时刻把结果定下来
senses.example: That vote was crucial to the plan.
senses.exampleCN: 那次投票对这项计划是决定性的。
senses.why: Where two roads part, one step decides the rest.
senses.whyCN: 两条路分岔的地方，一步就定下余下的路。

intro.en: Crucial comes from Latin crux, a cross, through Medieval Latin crucialis.
intro.cn: crucial 源自拉丁语 crux（十字），经中世纪拉丁语 crucialis 而来。

items.en: Crux meant a cross, where two lines met.
items.cn: crux 指十字，是两条线相交之处。

items.en: Crucialis meant belonging to a cross.
items.cn: crucialis 意为与十字有关的。

items.en: A crossroad forced a traveller to choose.
items.cn: 十字路口迫使行人做出选择。

items.en: Crucial first meant shaped like a cross.
items.cn: crucial 最初意为十字形的。

items.en: It took the sense of decisive, like a crossroad.
items.cn: 它取得如十字路口般「决定性」的意思。

items.en: It now simply means extremely important.
items.cn: 今天它只表示极其重要。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the cruc- stem, and the meaning group names other words for what decides an outcome.
note.cn: 形近组共享 cruc- 词干，近义组列出其他表示决定成败的说法。

entries.definition: a mark or shape of two lines
entries.definitionCN: 两条线构成的记号或形状

entries.definition: the central point of a problem
in a way that decides everything
so important that the result depends on it

normalIntro.en: These hooks start at a narrow bridge and end at a crossroad with no sign.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从一座窄桥开始，最后落到一个没有路牌的十字路口。

normal.en: Crucial hides a cross: a place where you must choose.
normal.cn: crucial 里藏着一个十字：那是你必须选的地方。

normal.en: One step on a narrow bridge decides the climb.
normal.cn: 窄桥上的第一步，定下整次攀登。

normal.en: Not everything matters; one thing matters most.
normal.cn: 不是一切都重要，只有一样最重要。

normal.en: At a crossroad, both roads look the same in the dark.
normal.cn: 在十字路口，黑暗里两条路看起来一模一样。

normal.en: Say crucial when the whole plan hangs on it.
normal.cn: 整个计划都挂在上面时，就说至关重要。

abstract.en: Picture a plank over a deep gap.
abstract.cn: 想象一块木板横在深沟上。

abstract.en: Picture a hand on a rail, holding steady.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手扶住栏杆，稳住不动。

abstract.en: Picture two roads splitting with no sign.
abstract.cn: 想象两条路分开，却没有路牌。

examples.en: Clean water is crucial to public health.
examples.cn: 清洁的水对公共健康至关重要。

examples.en: The next ten minutes were crucial.
examples.cn: 接下来的十分钟是决定性的。

examples.en: Trust plays a crucial role in any team.
examples.cn: 信任在任何团队里都起关键作用。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 crucial 记成一个十字路口：往左往右全看这一步，所以它至关重要。

root: 源自拉丁语 crux（十字）与中世纪拉丁语 crucialis；本义是「十字形的」，因十字路口必须做出抉择，19 世纪起引申为决定性的、至关重要的。

sensesIntro.en: From the weight of one thing, to the moment that settles the rest.
sensesIntro.cn: 从一样东西的分量，到把余下一切定下来的那一刻。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a narrow bridge over a deep gap.
core.cn: 核心意象：横在深沟上的一座窄桥。

branches.en: One factor carries the weight of all the others.
branches.cn: 一个因素，扛着其余全部因素的分量。

branches.en: At a crossroad, a single step settles the direction.
branches.cn: 在十字路口，一步就定下方向。

branches.en: What is decisive is decisive because it is needed.
branches.cn: 决定性的东西之所以决定性，是因为它被需要。

branches.en: Remove it, and the whole plan falls.
branches.cn: 把它抽走，整个计划就塌了。

branches.en: The moment is small, but everything hangs on it.
branches.cn: 那一刻很小，可一切都挂在它上面。

intro.en: Crucial is built on the Latin crux, a cross, with the adjective suffix -al.
intro.cn: crucial 建在拉丁语 crux（十字）之上，加了形容词后缀 -al。

latinIntro.en: The Latin crux also gives cross, crux and crusade.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 crux 还生出 cross、crux 与 crusade。

items.example: The timing is crucial.

items.meaning: in a way that decides the result
items.example: Crucially, the door was left open.
The report stressed the cruciality of water.
items.exampleCN: 报告强调了水的重要性。

items.example: A cross marked the spot.
items.exampleCN: 一个十字标出了那个地点。

items.meaning: the central point of a problem
items.example: That is the crux of the matter.
She led a crusade for clean air.
items.exampleCN: 她发起了一场争取清洁空气的运动。

items.example: The church has a cruciform plan.
items.exampleCN: 这座教堂是十字形平面。

items.meaning: to put to death on a cross
items.example: The story says he was crucified.
items.exampleCN: 故事说他被钉上了十字架。

latinEntries.example: Latin crux named the crossing point.
latinEntries.exampleCN: 拉丁语 crux 指相交之处。

definition_zh: 残忍的；残酷的；令人痛苦的
definition_en: willing to make others suffer, or hard and painful to bear
core_image: 一只脚悬在一只小虫上方，迟迟不落下
scene: 孩子把蚂蚁扣在玻璃杯下，笑着看它乱撞。It was cruel to trap the ant and watch it struggle.
sceneCN: 这里 cruel 指「残忍的」（第 1 个义项：以别人的痛苦为乐）；句意是把蚂蚁扣住、看它挣扎，是很残忍的。

pos.zh: 残忍的；残酷的；令人痛苦的

senses.title: Pleased by pain
senses.definition: willing to cause pain and taking pleasure in it
senses.definitionCN: 愿意让别人痛苦，并以此取乐
senses.example: It is cruel to laugh at a child who falls.
senses.exampleCN: 嘲笑摔倒的孩子是残忍的。
senses.why: Pain should end a joke, never be its point.
senses.whyCN: 痛苦该让玩笑停下，而不该成为玩笑的目的。

senses.title: Causing suffering
senses.definition: causing pain, whether on purpose or not
senses.definitionCN: 无论有意与否都造成痛苦
senses.example: The long drought was cruel to the farmers.
senses.exampleCN: 漫长的旱情对农民很残酷。
senses.why: The world can wound without any hand behind it.
senses.whyCN: 世界本身就会伤人，不需要谁在背后动手。

senses.title: Hard to bear
senses.definition: so hard or severe that it is painful to accept
senses.definitionCN: 艰难或严酷到令人难以接受
senses.example: Losing in the last minute was a cruel blow.
senses.exampleCN: 最后一刻输掉是沉重的一击。
senses.why: A fact can strike as hard as a fist.
senses.whyCN: 一个事实能像拳头一样砸下来。

intro.en: Cruel comes from Latin crudelis, hard-hearted, from crudus, raw.
intro.cn: cruel 源自拉丁语 crudelis（心硬的），其根是 crudus（生的）。

items.en: Crudelis described a hard heart that felt no pity.
items.cn: crudelis 形容一颗不觉怜悯的硬心。

items.en: It grew from crudus, raw, meaning not softened.
items.cn: 它出自 crudus（生的），意即没有软化。

items.en: Cruel named a person who took joy in pain.
items.cn: cruel 指以他人痛苦为乐的人。

items.en: Cruel entered English for harsh masters and hard acts.
items.cn: cruel 进入英语，用于严厉的主人与冷酷的行为。

items.en: It also describes fate, weather, and blows.
items.cn: 它也能形容命运、天气与打击。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the cru- stem, and the meaning group names other kinds of hardness.
note.cn: 形近组共享 cru- 词干，近义组列出其他表示狠硬的说法。

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with a foot held in the air and end with words that land like stones.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从一只停在半空的脚开始，落到像石头一样砸下的话。

normal.en: Cruel hearts do not feel the weight they press.
normal.cn: 狠心的人感觉不到自己压下去的分量。

normal.en: A joke that needs a victim is not a joke.
normal.cn: 需要一个受害者的玩笑，就不是玩笑。

normal.en: Fate can be cruel without having any hands.
normal.cn: 命运没有手，也能很残忍。

normal.en: The last minute is often the cruellest minute.
normal.cn: 最后一分钟常常是最残酷的一分钟。

normal.en: Cruel is what pity forgot to soften.
normal.cn: cruel 就是怜悯忘了去软化的东西。

abstract.en: Picture a hand that stops just above a small insect.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手停在一只小虫上方。

abstract.en: Picture a crowd laughing and one person walking away.
abstract.cn: 想象一群人笑着，一个人转身走开。

abstract.en: Picture frost killing flowers that had just opened.
abstract.cn: 想象霜打死刚开的花。

examples.en: It is cruel to keep a large dog in a small cage.
examples.cn: 把大狗关在小笼子里是残忍的。

examples.en: The old king was cruel to those who disobeyed.
examples.cn: 老国王对不服从他的人很残酷。

examples.en: Losing the farm was a cruel lesson for the family.
examples.cn: 失去农场对这家人是残酷的一课。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 cruel 记成「心硬」：cru 是生的，el 像一道划痕，心没被软化，就会划伤别人。

root: 源自拉丁语 crudelis（心硬的、无情的），与 crudus（生的）同源，经古法语 cruel 进入英语；本义是心未软化，对他人的痛痒无感。

sensesIntro.en: From taking pleasure in pain, to causing it, to bearing what cannot be softened.
sensesIntro.cn: 从以别人的痛为乐，到造成痛苦，再到承受无法软化的事。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a foot held above a small insect.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只脚悬在一只小虫上方。

branches.en: A hard heart can watch pain and smile.
branches.cn: 硬起来的心能看着痛苦还笑。

branches.en: Harm may come from a will or from the world.
branches.cn: 伤害可能来自意志，也可能来自世界。

branches.en: Some blows are too heavy to soften.
branches.cn: 有些打击重得无法软化。

branches.en: The one who enjoys pain and the drought share a name.
branches.cn: 以痛苦为乐的人与旱情共用一个词。

branches.en: What hurts us is called cruel, whatever its source.
branches.cn: 凡是伤到我们的，不管来自哪里，都叫残忍。

intro.en: Cruel and crude share the Latin crudus, raw, which grew into two kinds of hardness.
intro.cn: cruel 与 crude 共享拉丁语 crudus（生的），后来长成两种不同的硬。

latinIntro.en: The Latin crudelis, hard-hearted, is the root behind this family.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 crudelis（心硬的）是这一族词背后的根。

items.example: A cruel word can last for years.
items.exampleCN: 一句残忍的话能留很多年。

items.meaning: the act or habit of being cruel
items.example: The cruelty of the guard was well known.
items.exampleCN: 那个看守的残忍人人皆知。

items.example: He was cruelly treated as a child.
items.exampleCN: 他小时候受到残忍对待。

items.example: A cruel-hearted ruler feared no one.
items.exampleCN: 铁石心肠的统治者谁也不怕。

items.example: The cruelness of the winter surprised them.
items.exampleCN: 那个冬天的严酷让他们意外。

items.example: Crude wood must be dried first.
The wall was crudely built.
The crudity of his answer shocked her.
items.exampleCN: 他回答的粗鲁让她震惊。

definition_en: to shed tears, or to call out loudly
core_image: 一个孩子站在门口，眼泪往下掉，同时大声喊人
scene: 孩子摔在门口，眼泪掉下来，放声喊人。She began to cry when the door closed behind her.
sceneCN: 这里 cry 指「哭」（第 1 个义项：因悲伤或疼痛而流泪）；句意是门在她身后关上时，她哭了起来。

senses.title: Shed tears
senses.definition: to let tears fall because of pain or sadness
senses.definitionCN: 因疼痛或悲伤而流泪
senses.example: The baby cried all night.
senses.exampleCN: 婴儿哭了一整夜。
senses.why: Tears are the body speaking when words fail.
senses.whyCN: 说不出话时，眼泪替身体开口。

senses.title: Call out loudly
senses.definition: to shout loudly so as to be heard
senses.definitionCN: 大声喊叫以让人听见
senses.example: He cried out when the door slammed.
senses.exampleCN: 门砰地关上时他叫了一声。
senses.why: A voice thrown far, hoping someone catches it.
senses.whyCN: 声音被扔得很远，希望有人接住。

senses.title: The call of an animal
senses.definition: the loud call of a bird or animal
senses.definitionCN: 鸟或动物响亮的叫声
senses.example: We heard the cry of a fox at dusk.
senses.exampleCN: 黄昏时我们听见狐狸的叫声。
senses.why: Every kind of creature has a voice of its own.
senses.whyCN: 每一种生灵都有自己的嗓子。

intro.en: Cry comes from Old French crier, from Latin quiritare, to wail and call for help.
intro.cn: cry 源自古法语 crier，更早出自拉丁语 quiritare（哀号、呼救）。

items.en: Quiritare meant to wail and call for help.
items.cn: quiritare 意为哀号并呼救。

items.en: Crier meant to shout or to weep.
items.cn: crier 意为大声喊或哭泣。

items.en: Cry first meant to call out to someone.
items.cn: cry 最初指朝某人呼喊。

items.en: It also came to mean shedding tears.
items.cn: 它也开始表示流泪。

items.en: It names the call of birds and animals too.
items.cn: 它也能指鸟兽的叫声。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the -ry ending or the cr- opening, and the meaning group names other sounds of grief.
note.cn: 形近组共享 -ry 结尾或 cr- 开头，近义组列出其他表达悲伤的声音。

entries.definition: a long high cry of pain

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with a child at a door and end with a fox on a dark hill.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从门口一个孩子开始，落到黑山坡上的一只狐狸。

normal.en: Tears first, then a voice, then a word.
normal.cn: 先有眼泪，再有声音，最后才有话。

normal.en: To cry is to let the body speak.
normal.cn: cry 就是让身体开口。

normal.en: A cry for help is meant to travel far.
normal.cn: 呼救的那一声，本来就要传得很远。

normal.en: Foxes cry at dusk without any sorrow.
normal.cn: 狐狸在黄昏叫，并不带悲伤。

normal.en: A cry can be tears or a shout, one word holds both.
normal.cn: 哭声与喊声共用一个词。

abstract.en: Picture a face turned up, eyes full.
abstract.cn: 想象一张仰起的脸，眼里满是水。

abstract.en: Picture a shout crossing an empty street.
abstract.cn: 想象一声喊穿过空街。

abstract.en: Picture a fox standing still on a hill.
abstract.cn: 想象一只狐狸停在山坡上。

examples.en: The child cried when the light went out.
examples.cn: 灯灭时孩子哭了。

examples.en: She heard a cry in the dark street.
examples.cn: 她在黑街上听见一声喊叫。

examples.en: Birds cry at dawn outside the window.
examples.cn: 鸟儿在窗外天亮时叫。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 cry 记成「开口」：眼里开口是哭，嗓子里开口是喊。

root: 源自古法语 crier，更早出自拉丁语 quiritare（哀号、呼救）；本义是大声呼救，后同时指流泪与鸟兽的叫声。

sensesIntro.en: From tears, to a loud call, to the voice of an animal.
sensesIntro.cn: 从眼泪，到高声呼喊，再到动物的叫声。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a child at the door with tears and a shout.
core.cn: 核心意象：门口一个流着泪又喊着人的孩子。

branches.en: Tears answer a feeling that has no words.
branches.cn: 眼泪回应一种说不出口的感受。

branches.en: A shout is thrown out so that someone hears.
branches.cn: 喊声被扔出去，是为了让人听见。

branches.en: Birds and beasts cry without any sadness.
branches.cn: 鸟兽的叫声并不带悲伤。

branches.en: Both tears and shouts come from the same open mouth.
branches.cn: 眼泪与喊声都出自同一张张开的嘴。

branches.en: A human call and an animal call share a name.
branches.cn: 人的喊声与动物的叫声共用一个词。

intro.en: Cry forms words for calling out, for weeping, and for those who cannot stop.
intro.cn: cry 组成一族词，关于呼喊、哭泣，以及停不下来的人。

latinIntro.en: The Latin quiritare, to call for help, is the old root under cry.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 quiritare（呼救）是 cry 古老的根。

items.example: The baby will cry soon.
There is no crying over lost time.
items.exampleCN: 为失去的时间哭泣没有用。

items.example: The town crier rang his bell.
items.exampleCN: 镇上的报信人摇响了铃。

items.example: Do not be a crybaby.
The plan raised an outcry.
items.exampleCN: 这个计划引来强烈抗议。

items.example: Critics decry the new rule.
items.exampleCN: 批评者谴责这条新规定。

items.example: She cried out in pain.

items.meaning: a shout used to urge fighters
items.example: The soldiers raised a battle cry.

definition_en: relating to the way of life, art, and beliefs of a group of people
core_image: 一条老街上，戏台、书店和庙挤在同一条巷子里
scene: 老街上戏台、书店和庙挤在一条巷子里，都是这座城的样子。The festival is the cultural heart of the town.
sceneCN: 这里 cultural 指「文化的」（第 1 个义项：与一个群体的生活方式、艺术和信仰有关）；句意是这个节庆是这座镇的文化核心。

senses.title: Of a way of life
senses.definition: relating to the customs and beliefs of a group
senses.definitionCN: 与一个群体的习俗和信仰有关的
senses.example: Food is a cultural matter, not just a physical one.
senses.exampleCN: 饮食是文化问题，不只是生理问题。
senses.why: What a group repeats becomes its way of life.
senses.whyCN: 一个群体反复做的事，就成了它的生活方式。

senses.title: Of art and learning
senses.definition: relating to art, music, books, and learning
senses.definitionCN: 与艺术、音乐、书籍和学问有关的
senses.example: The city offers many cultural events.
senses.exampleCN: 这座城市有很多文艺活动。
senses.why: A society keeps its best made things on show.
senses.whyCN: 一个社会把做得最好的东西摆出来给人看。

senses.title: Of refined taste
senses.definition: showing refined taste and education
senses.definitionCN: 表现出修养与教育的
senses.example: She moves in cultural circles.
senses.exampleCN: 她出入有文化气息的圈子。
senses.why: Training of the mind leaves a visible mark.
senses.whyCN: 心智受过训练，会留下看得见的痕迹。

intro.en: Cultural is Latin cultura, tilling, plus -alis, belonging to; English formed it in the nineteenth century.
intro.cn: cultural 由拉丁语 cultura（耕种）加 -alis（属于）构成，十九世纪在英语中成形。

items.en: Cultura meant tilling the soil and giving care.
items.cn: cultura 指耕种土地并加以照料。

items.en: -Alis meant belonging to or relating to.
items.cn: -alis 意为属于或关于。

items.en: Cultural first meant of cultivation, of land or mind.
items.cn: cultural 最初指耕种或心智培养的。

items.en: It shifted to the arts and way of life of a people.
items.cn: 它转向一个群体的艺术与生活方式。

items.en: It now covers food, dress, music, and belief.
items.cn: 如今它涵盖饮食、服饰、音乐与信仰。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the cult- stem, and the meaning group names other words for social life and taste.
note.cn: 形近组共享 cult- 词干，近义组列出其他关于社会生活与品味的说法。

entries.definition: the way of life of a people
a small group with strong beliefs

entries.definitionCN: 举止与品味经过打磨的

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with a narrow street holding a stage and a temple and end with a trained eye.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从一条挤着戏台与庙的窄巷开始，落到一双受过训练的眼睛。

normal.en: Culture plus -al makes an adjective about a whole way of life.
normal.cn: culture 加 -al，成了描述整套生活方式的形容词。

normal.en: A festival can be the heart of a town.
normal.cn: 一个节庆可以是一座镇的心脏。

normal.en: Cultural things are learned from others, not carried in blood.
normal.cn: 文化的东西是向别人学来的，不写在血里。

normal.en: Food, dress, and songs all carry culture.
normal.cn: 饮食、服饰与歌都带着文化。

normal.en: A cultured person shows what a culture trained.
normal.cn: 有修养的人，显出文化训练过的痕迹。

abstract.en: Picture a stage lit beside a small bookshop.
abstract.cn: 想象一座亮着灯的戏台挨着小小书店。

abstract.en: Picture hands passing food across a long table.
abstract.cn: 想象一双手把食物递过长桌。

abstract.en: Picture a child copying a dance step.
abstract.cn: 想象一个孩子跟着学舞步。

examples.en: The two countries began a cultural exchange.
examples.cn: 两国开始了文化交流。

examples.en: Old songs are part of our cultural heritage.
examples.cn: 老歌是我们文化遗产的一部分。

examples.en: The town has a busy cultural life.
examples.cn: 这镇的文化生活很热闹。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 cultural 记成「种出来的」：culture 原是耕种，一个群体长期养出的习惯与艺术，就是文化。

root: 由拉丁语 cultura（耕种、照料）加形容词后缀 -alis 构成；十九世纪进入英语，本义与栽培有关，后指一个群体的艺术、信仰与生活方式。

sensesIntro.en: From a group's way of life, to its arts, to a refined manner.
sensesIntro.cn: 从一个群体的生活方式，到它的艺术，再到文雅的举止。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a stage, a bookshop, and a temple in one narrow street.
core.cn: 核心意象：一条窄巷里同时有戏台、书店和庙。

branches.en: Customs shared by a group are called cultural.
branches.cn: 一个群体共享的习俗被称为文化的。

branches.en: Art and learning are the visible face of that life.
branches.cn: 艺术与学问是这种生活看得见的脸。

branches.en: A trained taste shows culture in one person.
branches.cn: 受过训练的品味，把文化显在一个人身上。

branches.en: A way of life and its art cannot be separated.
branches.cn: 生活方式与它的艺术分不开。

branches.en: What a society makes, a person can learn to love.
branches.cn: 社会做出来的东西，个人可以学着去爱。

intro.en: Cultural sits in the Latin cultura family, with culture, cultured, and agriculture around it.
intro.cn: cultural 属于拉丁语 cultura 一族，周围有 culture、cultured 与 agriculture。

latinIntro.en: The Latin cultura, tilling, is the root that carries -al into cultural.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 cultura（耕种）是把 -al 带进 cultural 的根。

items.example: Cultural habits pass down.
Culturally, the two towns differ.
items.exampleCN: 从文化上说，这两座镇不同。

items.example: Culture lives in small habits.
He is a cultured listener.
Uncultured speech can offend.
London is a multicultural city.
items.exampleCN: 伦敦是座多元文化城市。

items.example: They study cross-cultural trade.
Sociocultural forces shape taste.
items.exampleCN: 社会与文化的力量塑造品味。

definition_zh: 文化；文艺；（细菌等的）培养物
definition_en: the way of life of a people, or cells and bacteria grown for study
core_image: 一张长桌上摆着不同人家的饭菜，各有各的做法
scene: 长桌上摆着好几户人家的饭菜，做法各不一样。Food is one of the clearest signs of a culture.
sceneCN: 这里 culture 指「文化」（第 1 个义项：一个群体共同的生活方式与观念）；句意是饮食是文化最清楚的标志之一。

senses.title: A people's way of life
senses.definition: the customs and beliefs shared by a group of people
senses.definitionCN: 一个群体共享的习俗与信念
senses.example: Every culture has its own rules of politeness.
senses.exampleCN: 每种文化都有自己的礼貌规矩。
senses.why: A group agrees on what to say, eat, and honour.
senses.whyCN: 一群人约好怎么说、怎么吃、敬什么。

senses.title: Art and learning
senses.definition: the arts, music, and learning of a society
senses.definitionCN: 一个社会的艺术、音乐与学问
senses.example: The museum is a storehouse of culture.
senses.exampleCN: 博物馆是文化的仓库。
senses.why: A society keeps what it wants to remember.
senses.whyCN: 一个社会把想记住的东西收起来。

senses.title: Growing cells
senses.definition: cells or bacteria grown for study
senses.definitionCN: 为研究而培养的细胞或细菌
senses.example: The lab keeps a culture of the bacteria.
senses.exampleCN: 实验室保存着这种细菌的培养物。
senses.why: Life can be coaxed to grow in a dish.
senses.whyCN: 生命可以被哄着在皿里长起来。

intro.en: Culture comes from Latin cultura, tilling, from colere, to till and to honour.
intro.cn: culture 源自拉丁语 cultura（耕种），其根是 colere（耕种、敬奉）。

items.en: Colere meant to till the soil and to honour.
items.cn: colere 指耕种土地，也指敬奉。

items.en: Cultura named the tilling and the care it needs.
items.cn: cultura 指耕种以及所需的照料。

items.en: Culture first meant the tilling of land.
items.cn: culture 最初指耕地。

items.en: It moved to the training of the mind.
items.cn: 它转向心智的培养。

items.en: It named the arts and way of life of a people.
items.cn: 它指一个群体的艺术与生活方式。

items.en: It also meant growing bacteria in a lab.
items.cn: 它也指在实验室培养细菌。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the cult- stem, and the meaning group names other words for a shared way of life.
note.cn: 形近组共享 cult- 词干，近义组列出其他表示共同生活方式的说法。

entries.definition: of the way of life of a group
a small group with strong beliefs
an advanced stage of social life
a usual way of doing something

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with a long table of food and end with a dish of growing cells.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从一张摆满食物的长桌开始，落到一皿正在生长的细胞。

normal.en: Culture began as a word for digging in the soil.
normal.cn: culture 最初是刨土的字眼。

normal.en: What we eat says where we come from.
normal.cn: 我们吃什么，说明我们从哪里来。

normal.en: A museum keeps what a society chose to remember.
normal.cn: 博物馆收着一个社会选择记住的东西。

normal.en: The lab grows a culture the way a garden grows beans.
normal.cn: 实验室培养细菌，像园子种豆。

normal.en: Culture is learned, shared, and passed on.
normal.cn: 文化是学来的、共享的、传下去的。

abstract.en: Picture many hands reaching across one table.
abstract.cn: 想象许多只手伸过同一张桌子。

abstract.en: Picture a dish of clear jelly on a lab bench.
abstract.cn: 想象实验台上一皿透明的胶状物。

abstract.en: Picture a song taught to a child without a book.
abstract.cn: 想象一首不用书就教给孩子的歌。

examples.en: She studies the culture of mountain villages.
examples.cn: 她研究山村的文化。

examples.en: The lab grew a culture from a single cell.
examples.cn: 实验室从单个细胞培养出培养物。

examples.en: Music is central to their culture.
examples.cn: 音乐在他们的文化中处于中心。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 culture 记成「耕种」：拉丁语 colere 是耕地，心里的东西也要一季季种出来。

root: 源自拉丁语 cultura（耕种、照料），其根是 colere（耕种、敬奉）；本义是种地，后指心智的培养，再指一个群体的艺术、信仰与生活方式，也指实验室里的培养物。

sensesIntro.en: From tilling the land, to training the mind, to a whole way of life.
sensesIntro.cn: 从种地，到培养心智，再到整套生活方式。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: many dishes from many homes on one long table.
core.cn: 核心意象：一张长桌上摆着许多人家各不相同的菜。

branches.en: A group that shares habits and beliefs has a culture.
branches.cn: 共享习惯与信念的群体，就有文化。

branches.en: Its art and learning are stored and shown.
branches.cn: 它的艺术与学问被收藏并展示。

branches.en: A lab grows life in a dish and calls it a culture.
branches.cn: 实验室在皿里养出生命，也叫 culture。

branches.en: Both a people and a dish are tended until they grow.
branches.cn: 人群与培养皿都要照料才会生长。

branches.en: Keeping and growing are two sides of the same word.
branches.cn: 收藏与培养是同一个词的两面。

intro.en: Culture is the parent word for cultural, cultured, and a wide family of compounds.
intro.cn: culture 是 cultural、cultured 以及一大族合成词的母词。

latinIntro.en: The Latin colere, to till, is the root under culture and its whole family.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 colere（耕种）是 culture 及其整族词背后的根。

items.example: Culture is learned, not born.
items.exampleCN: 文化是学来的，不是天生的。

items.example: Cultural exchange opens minds.
She has a cultured manner.
They are culturing cells in the lab.
items.exampleCN: 他们正在实验室培养细胞。

items.example: Agriculture feeds the city.
Horticulture is taught here.

items.meaning: a small culture inside a larger one
items.example: Skaters form a subculture.
items.exampleCN: 滑板者形成一个亚文化。

items.meaning: a culture against the main one
items.example: The counterculture rejected old rules.
items.exampleCN: 反主流文化拒绝旧规矩。

definition_en: a small round container for drinking, the amount it holds, or a prize cup
core_image: 两只手捧着一只热杯，杯口冒着白气
scene: 两只手捧着一只热杯，杯口还冒着白气。She filled the cup with hot tea and held it close.
sceneCN: 这里 cup 指「杯子」（第 1 个义项：喝水用的小圆容器）；句意是她把杯子倒满热茶，捧在手里。

senses.title: A drinking container
senses.definition: a small round container used for drinking
senses.definitionCN: 用来喝水的小圆容器
senses.example: He put the cup beside the plate.
senses.exampleCN: 他把杯子放在盘子旁。
senses.why: A hand needs something round to hold hot liquid.
senses.whyCN: 手需要一个圆东西来端住热水。

senses.title: The amount it holds
senses.definition: the amount that a cup holds
senses.definitionCN: 一只杯子能装的量
senses.example: Add two cups of flour.
senses.exampleCN: 加两杯面粉。
senses.why: A container becomes a unit of measure.
senses.whyCN: 容器本身变成了计量单位。

senses.title: A prize
senses.definition: a prize shaped like a cup, or a contest that awards one
senses.definitionCN: 杯形奖品，或颁发此奖的比赛
senses.example: The team raised the cup above their heads.
senses.exampleCN: 球队把奖杯举过头顶。
senses.why: A shared cup once marked a shared honour.
senses.whyCN: 共用的杯子，曾标记共同的荣誉。

intro.en: Cup comes from Old English cuppe, from Latin cuppa, a drinking vessel.
intro.cn: cup 源自古英语 cuppe，更早出自拉丁语 cuppa（饮器）。

items.en: Cuppa meant a drinking vessel.
items.cn: cuppa 指饮水的容器。

items.en: Cupa meant a tub or a barrel.
items.cn: cupa 指盆或桶。

items.en: Cuppe came into English with the Latin word.
items.cn: cuppe 随拉丁词进入英语。

items.en: Cup also meant the amount it could hold.
items.cn: cup 也指它能装的量。

items.en: A decorated cup became a prize for a winner.
items.cn: 装饰过的杯子成了给胜者的奖品。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the short cu- shape, and the meaning group names other things you drink from or win.
note.cn: 形近组共享短小的 cu- 形状，近义组列出其他饮具或奖品。

entries.definition: a soft hat with a flat front
a police officer, in informal speech
a large cup with a handle
a cup made of clear material

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with warm steam and end with a silver prize held high.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从热腾腾的白气开始，落到被高高举起的银杯。

normal.en: Two hands make the shape of a cup before a cup exists.
normal.cn: 杯子还不存在时，双手已经围出杯子的形状。

normal.en: A cup is a measure as soon as it holds something.
normal.cn: 杯子一装东西，就成了量具。

normal.en: Hot tea needs a handle or a pair of hands.
normal.cn: 热茶需要把手，或者一双手。

normal.en: A prize cup is a cup you cannot drink from.
normal.cn: 奖杯是一只你没法用来喝水的杯子。

normal.en: Fill it, hold it, empty it, wash it.
normal.cn: 倒满，捧住，喝空，洗净。

abstract.en: Picture steam curling above a thick white rim.
abstract.cn: 想象白气从厚厚的杯口卷起。

abstract.en: Picture a spoon standing in a cup of flour.
abstract.cn: 想象一把勺子立在一杯面粉里。

abstract.en: Picture a silver cup with many names cut into it.
abstract.cn: 想象一只刻满名字的银杯。

examples.en: She poured a cup of tea for each guest.
examples.cn: 她给每位客人倒了一杯茶。

examples.en: The bowl and the cup are both broken.
examples.cn: 碗和杯子都碎了。

examples.en: Our team won the cup last year.
examples.cn: 我们队去年赢得了奖杯。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 cup 记成「围起来的手心」：两只手一合，就成了能盛水的形状。

root: 源自古英语 cuppe，更早出自拉丁语 cuppa（饮器）；本义是喝水的小容器，后引申为一杯之量与杯形奖品。

sensesIntro.en: From a vessel in the hand, to a measure in a recipe, to a prize on a shelf.
sensesIntro.cn: 从手里的容器，到食谱里的量，再到架上的奖品。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two hands around a warm cup with steam above it.
core.cn: 核心意象：两只手捧着一只热杯，杯口冒着白气。

branches.en: A round vessel fits a hand and holds a drink.
branches.cn: 圆容器贴合手，也装得住饮料。

branches.en: Once it holds a known amount, it becomes a measure.
branches.cn: 一旦装着已知的量，它就成了量具。

branches.en: A cup with no drink becomes a prize.
branches.cn: 不装饮料的杯子，成了奖品。

branches.en: The thing and the amount share one short word.
branches.cn: 容器与分量共用一个短词。

branches.en: Both a measure and a prize are held up for all to see.
branches.cn: 量杯与奖杯都会被举起来给人看。

intro.en: Cup forms compounds for small vessels, measures, and a famous prize.
intro.cn: cup 组成一族合成词，关于小容器、量与大奖。

latinIntro.en: The Latin cuppa, a drinking vessel, is the root behind cup and cupboard.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 cuppa（饮器）是 cup 与 cupboard 背后的根。

items.example: The cup is full of milk.
Add a cupful of rice.
A teacup sat on the saucer.
items.exampleCN: 一只小茶杯放在茶碟上。

items.example: He washed his coffee cup.

items.meaning: a small cake baked in a paper cup
items.example: She brought cupcakes to school.
items.exampleCN: 她把纸杯蛋糕带到学校。

items.meaning: a support that holds a cup
items.example: The car has a cup holder.
The World Cup is held every four years.
items.exampleCN: 世界杯每四年举办一次。

items.example: The plates are in the cupboard.

definition_en: a piece of furniture with doors and shelves, used for dishes or food
core_image: 一扇木柜门打开，里面叠着碗和杯子
scene: 厨房里那扇木门一开，里面叠着碗和杯。The plates are kept in the cupboard above the sink.
sceneCN: 这里 cupboard 指「碗柜」（第 1 个义项：带门和架子、用来放餐具的家具）；句意是盘子放在水槽上方的碗柜里。

senses.title: A storage cabinet
senses.definition: a piece of furniture with doors and shelves for dishes or food
senses.definitionCN: 带门和架子、放餐具或食物的家具
senses.example: Put the bowls back in the cupboard.
senses.exampleCN: 把碗放回碗柜。
senses.why: Doors hide the clutter and keep dust out.
senses.whyCN: 柜门挡住杂乱，也挡住灰尘。

senses.title: A small closed space
senses.definition: a small closet built into a wall
senses.definitionCN: 嵌在墙里的小储藏空间
senses.example: The broom is in the cupboard under the stairs.
senses.exampleCN: 扫帚在楼梯下的壁橱里。
senses.why: A wall can hold a room no one counts.
senses.whyCN: 一堵墙里能藏一间没人算进去的小屋。

senses.title: A bare cupboard
senses.definition: a state of having no food or money left
senses.definitionCN: 食物或钱都已见底的状态
senses.example: After the long winter the cupboard was bare.
senses.exampleCN: 漫长的冬天过后，柜子空了。
senses.why: An empty shelf tells a whole story.
senses.whyCN: 一格空架子就能讲完一个故事。

intro.en: Cupboard began as Middle English cuppebord, a board for cups, from cup and bord.
intro.cn: cupboard 原是中古英语 cuppebord，即放杯子的板，由 cup 与 bord 合成。

items.en: Cuppebord joined cup and bord, a board.
items.cn: cuppebord 由 cup 与 bord（板）合成。

items.en: It meant a sideboard for cups and plates.
items.cn: 它指放杯盘的边柜。

items.en: The word was shortened to cupboard.
items.cn: 这个词被缩短成 cupboard。

items.en: Cupboards gained doors and became closed.
items.cn: 碗柜装上柜门，成了封闭的家具。

items.en: It now means any cabinet for dishes or food.
items.cn: 如今它指任何放餐具或食物的柜子。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the cup- opening, and the meaning group names other closed storage furniture.
note.cn: 形近组共享 cup- 开头，近义组列出其他封闭的储物家具。

entries.definition: as much as a cupboard can hold
a small cake baked in a paper cup
a piece of furniture with shelves and doors
a small room for storing things
a small cupboard that can be locked

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with a board for cups and end with an empty shelf.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从一块放杯子的板开始，落到一格空架子。

normal.en: Cup plus board: first a shelf, then a box.
normal.cn: cup 加 board：先是板，后来成了箱。

normal.en: Say it fast and the p disappears: cupboard.
normal.cn: 说快了那个 p 就不见了：cupboard。

normal.en: A cupboard keeps dust off and clutter out of sight.
normal.cn: 碗柜挡住灰，也把杂乱藏起来。

normal.en: The plates live above the sink, behind two small doors.
normal.cn: 盘子的家在水槽上方，两扇小门后面。

normal.en: When the cupboard is bare, the story turns sad.
normal.cn: 柜子一空，故事就变苦了。

abstract.en: Picture two small doors opening on stacked bowls.
abstract.cn: 想象两扇小门打开，里面叠着碗。

abstract.en: Picture a broom leaning in a dark closet.
abstract.cn: 想象一把扫帚靠在黑暗的壁橱里。

abstract.en: Picture one empty shelf with a single crumb.
abstract.cn: 想象一格空架子上只有一点面包屑。

examples.en: The sugar is in the cupboard on the left.
examples.cn: 糖在左边的碗柜里。

examples.en: He built a cupboard for the kitchen.
examples.cn: 他为厨房做了一个橱柜。

examples.en: The cupboard was bare by the end of the month.
examples.cn: 到了月底，柜子已经空了。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 cupboard 记成「放杯子的板」：cup 加 board（板），一块放杯子的板，后来装上柜门。

root: 中古英语 cuppebord 由 cup（杯子）与 bord（板）合成，原指放杯盘的板架；十六世纪缩为 cupboard，十七世纪装上柜门，遂指碗柜。

sensesIntro.en: From a board for cups, to a closed cabinet, to an empty shelf that tells a story.
sensesIntro.cn: 从放杯子的板，到带门的柜子，再到能讲故事的空气架。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a wooden door opening on stacked bowls and cups.
core.cn: 核心意象：一扇木门打开，里面叠着碗和杯。

branches.en: A cabinet holds dishes behind closed doors.
branches.cn: 柜子把餐具收在关着的门后。

branches.en: A cupboard can also be a small room in a wall.
branches.cn: cupboard 也可以是墙里的小空间。

branches.en: A bare cupboard means there is nothing left.
branches.cn: 柜子空了，意味着什么都不剩。

branches.en: A big cupboard and a small closet both hide things.
branches.cn: 大碗柜与小壁橱都在藏东西。

branches.en: What is hidden may be dishes, or may be hunger.
branches.cn: 藏起来的可能是餐具，也可能是饥饿。

intro.en: Cupboard sits in the cup family, and keeps the old sense of a board in its spelling.
intro.cn: cupboard 属于 cup 一族，拼写里还留着「板」的旧义。

latinIntro.en: The Latin cuppa, a drinking vessel, is the root behind cup and cupboard alike.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 cuppa（饮器）是 cup 与 cupboard 共同的根。

items.example: The cupboard is full of bowls.

items.meaning: as much as a cupboard holds
items.example: They bought a cupboardful of rice.

items.meaning: affection shown for what one gets
items.example: The cat's purr was cupboard love.
items.exampleCN: 猫的呼噜是冲着食盆来的。

definition_en: eager to know or learn, or strange enough to attract notice
core_image: 一只猫把头探进刚打开的纸箱
scene: 纸箱刚打开，猫立刻把头探了进去。The children were curious about the old machine.
sceneCN: 这里 curious 指「好奇的」（第 1 个义项：急切想知道或了解的）；句意是孩子们对那台旧机器很好奇。

senses.title: Eager to know
senses.definition: wanting very much to know or learn something
senses.definitionCN: 非常想知道或了解某事的
senses.example: She was curious about the locked room.
senses.exampleCN: 她对那间锁着的房间很好奇。
senses.why: A closed door is a question standing up.
senses.whyCN: 一扇关着的门，就是一个立着的问题。

senses.title: Strange
senses.definition: unusual in a way that makes people notice
senses.definitionCN: 不寻常到引人注意的
senses.example: A curious smell came from the box.
senses.exampleCN: 箱子里传出一股奇怪的气味。
senses.why: What does not fit our pattern asks to be explained.
senses.whyCN: 不合我们套路的东西，会要求一个解释。

senses.title: Carefully made
senses.definition: made with care and skill, in older use
senses.definitionCN: 旧用法中指用心做成的
senses.example: The old clock is a curious piece of work.
senses.exampleCN: 这座旧钟是一件精细的作品。
senses.why: Care in making leaves a visible trace.
senses.whyCN: 制作时的用心会留下看得见的痕迹。

intro.en: Curious comes from Latin curiosus, careful and eager to know, from cura, care.
intro.cn: curious 源自拉丁语 curiosus（用心的、爱探究的），其根是 cura（关心）。

items.en: Cura meant care and attention.
items.cn: cura 意为关心与用心。

items.en: Curiosus meant full of care.
items.cn: curiosus 意为充满用心。

items.en: It then meant eager to know.
items.cn: 它后来指急于知道。

items.en: Curius kept the eager sense.
items.cn: curius 保留了急切这层意思。

items.en: Curious meant careful and skillful.
items.cn: curious 意为细心而有技艺的。

items.en: It settled into eager to know, and strange.
items.cn: 它固定为好奇的，也有奇怪的。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the cur- stem, and the meaning group names other words for wanting to know and for oddness.
note.cn: 形近组共享 cur- 词干，近义组列出其他表示想了解与古怪的说法。

entries.definition: to make a sick person well

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with a cat and a box and end with an old clock made by hand.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从猫与纸箱开始，落到一只手工做的旧钟。

normal.en: A curious mind treats every box as a door.
normal.cn: 好奇的心，把每个箱子都当成门。

normal.en: Cats are the picture of curious.
normal.cn: 猫就是好奇的样子。

normal.en: The same word means strange, because strangeness asks questions.
normal.cn: 同一个词也表示奇怪，因为古怪会引出问题。

normal.en: An old clock can be curious work, made with care.
normal.cn: 一只旧钟可以是一件精细的作品。

normal.en: Curious people learn faster and sleep less.
normal.cn: 好奇的人学得快，也睡得少。

abstract.en: Picture a cat with its head deep in a box.
abstract.cn: 想象一只猫把头埋进箱子里。

abstract.en: Picture a smell that makes you turn your head.
abstract.cn: 想象一股气味让你转过头。

abstract.en: Picture small gears fitted by a careful hand.
abstract.cn: 想象一只谨慎的手装好的小齿轮。

examples.en: The child was curious about the stars.
examples.cn: 这孩子对星星很好奇。

examples.en: I am curious to know how it ends.
examples.cn: 我很想知道结局。

examples.en: There was a curious mark on the wall.
examples.cn: 墙上有一个奇怪的痕迹。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 curious 记成「心里放不下」：cur 是关心，心里一直挂着，就变成了好奇。

root: 源自拉丁语 curiosus（用心的、爱探究的），其根是 cura（关心）；本义是用心，后指渴望知道，也指因少见而显得奇怪。

sensesIntro.en: From eager to know, to strange, to carefully made.
sensesIntro.cn: 从渴望知道，到奇怪，再到用心做成。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a cat pushing its head into a newly opened box.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只猫把头探进刚打开的纸箱。

branches.en: Something unknown pulls the mind toward it.
branches.cn: 未知的东西把心拉过去。

branches.en: A thing that does not fit is called curious too.
branches.cn: 不合套的东西，也叫奇怪的。

branches.en: Older speech used it for careful, fine work.
branches.cn: 较早的说法用它形容精细的活。

branches.en: The wish to know and the odd thing explain each other.
branches.cn: 想知道的愿望与古怪的东西彼此解释。

branches.en: Careful work and strange work both draw the eye.
branches.cn: 精细的活与古怪的活都招人看。

intro.en: Curious is the adjective that supports curiosity, curiously, and their compounds.
intro.cn: curious 是支撑 curiosity、curiously 及其合成词的形容词。

latinIntro.en: The Latin cura, care, is the root under curious and its whole family.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 cura（关心）是 curious 及其整族词背后的根。

items.example: He is curious about everything.
The door was curiously warm.
Curiosity is not a fault.
Her curiousness tired the guide.
An incurious mind misses much.
items.exampleCN: 毫无好奇心的头脑会错过很多。

items.example: The shelf held a small curio.

items.meaning: a shop selling odd old things
items.example: They met in a curiosity shop.
items.exampleCN: 他们在一家旧货店相遇。

items.example: Care can cure what drugs cannot.
items.exampleCN: 照料能治好药治不好的东西。

definition_en: the money a country uses, or the state of being widely used and believed
core_image: 柜台上摊开几张颜色各异的纸币，图案各不相同
scene: 换汇窗口前，一叠不同颜色的纸币被推到玻璃下面。She changed her currency before the flight.
sceneCN: 这里 currency 指「货币」（第 1 个义项：一国使用的钱）；句意是她在登机前兑换了货币。

senses.title: National money
senses.definition: the system of money that a country uses
senses.definitionCN: 一个国家所使用的货币制度
senses.example: The euro is the currency of many countries.
senses.exampleCN: 欧元是许多国家的货币。
senses.why: A country prints its own trust and asks others to accept it.
senses.whyCN: 一个国家印出自己的信用，再请别人接受它。

senses.title: Notes and coins
senses.definition: coins and paper notes used as a medium of exchange
senses.definitionCN: 用作交换媒介的硬币与纸币
senses.example: Foreign currency can be changed at the desk.
senses.exampleCN: 外币可以在那个柜台兑换。
senses.why: Value must take a form you can hand to another person.
senses.whyCN: 价值总得变成一种能递到别人手里的东西。

senses.title: Wide acceptance
senses.definition: the state of being widely used, repeated, or believed
senses.definitionCN: 被广泛使用、传述或相信的状态
senses.example: The rumour gained currency within a week.
senses.exampleCN: 那个传言一周之内就传开了。
senses.why: An idea becomes solid once many mouths carry it.
senses.whyCN: 一个想法被许多张嘴带着走，就变得实在了。

intro.en: Currency comes from Latin currere, to run, through the English word current and the suffix -cy.
intro.cn: currency 源自拉丁语 currere（跑、流动），经英语 current 加后缀 -cy 构成。

items.en: Currere meant to run, as water runs in a channel.
items.cn: currere 意为跑，就像水在河道里流。

items.en: Currens described what is running or flowing.
items.cn: currens 形容正在跑、正在流的东西。

items.en: Current first named the running flow of a river.
items.cn: current 最初指河水奔流。

items.en: Currency named the state of being in use or accepted.
items.cn: currency 指被使用、被接受的状态。

items.en: The word settled on the money that passes from hand to hand.
items.cn: 这个词最终落在人与人之间传递的钱上。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the curr- stem, and the meaning group names what people pay with.
note.cn: 形近组共享 curr- 词干，近义组列出人们用来付钱的东西。

entries.definitionCN: 现在正在发生或流动的

entries.definition: a small dried grape used in baking
coins and notes used to buy things
entries.definitionCN: 用来买东西的硬币和纸币

entries.definition: money in notes and coins, not in a bank
something offered as a means of payment
entries.definitionCN: 作为支付手段提供的东西

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with paper money leaving a hand and end with a rumour that will not stop travelling.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从一张离开手的纸币开始，落到一个停不下来的传言。

normal.en: Currency is value that keeps running between hands.
normal.cn: 货币就是在人与人之间不停跑动的价值。

normal.en: A note is only paper until a country says otherwise.
normal.cn: 纸币本来只是纸，直到国家开口赋予它意义。

normal.en: The same word covers money and rumour, because both circulate.
normal.cn: 同一个词既指钱又指传言，因为两者都在流通。

normal.en: When a saying gains currency, it starts to be spent like coins.
normal.cn: 一句话开始流行，就像硬币一样被花出去。

normal.en: Foreign currency is someone else's printed trust.
normal.cn: 外币，是别人印出来的信用。

abstract.en: Picture a banknote moving from one warm hand to another.
abstract.cn: 想象一张纸币从一只温热的手传到另一只。

abstract.en: Picture coins crossing a border in a small cloth bag.
abstract.cn: 想象硬币装在小布袋里越过边境。

abstract.en: Picture a sentence repeated in every kitchen until it sounds true.
abstract.cn: 想象一句话在每个厨房里被重复，直到听起来像真的。

examples.en: The local currency is the yuan.
examples.cn: 当地货币是元。

examples.en: Old sayings can gain currency again.
examples.cn: 老话也能重新流行起来。

examples.en: She kept some foreign currency for the trip.
examples.cn: 她为这次旅行留了一些外币。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 currency 记成「正在跑的钱」：curr 是跑，-ency 是状态，钱在人手之间跑来跑去，就是货币。

root: 源自拉丁语 currere（跑、流动），经古法语与英语 current 加后缀 -cy 构成；本义是「流动之物」，先指河水，后指流通中的钱，再指流传的说法。

sensesIntro.en: From the money a nation prints, to the notes in your hand, to an idea that circulates.
sensesIntro.cn: 从一国印出的钱，到手里的一张纸币，再到一个四处流传的想法。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: paper money passing from one hand to the next.
core.cn: 核心意象：一张纸币从一只手传到另一只手。

branches.en: A state declares what counts as money inside its borders.
branches.cn: 国家宣布在它的边界内什么算钱。

branches.en: Notes and coins are the physical form that value takes.
branches.cn: 纸币和硬币，是价值采取的具体形状。

branches.en: An idea that everyone repeats is said to have currency.
branches.cn: 人人都在重复的想法，就被说成「通行」。

branches.en: The money of a country and the notes in your pocket are one system.
branches.cn: 一国的货币和口袋里的纸币，是同一套东西。

branches.en: What circulates is trusted, whether it is a note or a rumour.
branches.cn: 凡是流通的都被信任，不管是纸币还是传言。

intro.en: Currency sits in the curr- family, where the idea of running grows into money and into words on everyone's lips.
intro.cn: currency 属于 curr- 这一族，「跑」的意思长成了钱，也长成了人人嘴边的话。

latinIntro.en: The Latin currere, to run, is the root under current, currency, and recur.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 currere（跑）是 current、currency 与 recur 共同的根。

items.exampleCN: 这种货币对美元贬值了。

items.meaning: a bank account for daily use
items.example: He opened a current account.

items.meaning: a place or act of changing money

The port earned hard currency.
items.exampleCN: 这个港口赚到了硬通货。

items.meaning: a sudden loss of trust in money

items.exampleCN: 货币危机让商店都空了。

items.meaning: a hidden flow beneath the surface
items.example: An undercurrent of anger ran through the room.
items.exampleCN: 房间里流动着一股暗藏的怒气。

items.example: Two concurrent meetings split the staff.
items.exampleCN: 两个同时召开的会议把员工分成了两半。

items.example: The pain may recur in winter.
items.exampleCN: 这种疼痛冬天可能再犯。

definition_zh: 当前的；现行的；水流；气流；电流
definition_en: happening or existing now, or a continuous flow of water, air, or electricity
core_image: 河水贴着石岸不停向前推，表面却看不出在动
scene: 河中央的水一刻不停地把木筏往下游推。The current pulled the raft downstream.
sceneCN: 这里 current 指「水流」（第 1 个义项：水的流动）；句意是水流把木筏往下游拖。

senses.title: Flowing water or air
senses.definition: a continuous flow of water or air in one direction
senses.definitionCN: 水或空气朝一个方向持续流动
senses.example: A strong current runs under the bridge.
senses.exampleCN: 桥下有一股强劲的水流。
senses.why: Water in motion carries whatever floats on it.
senses.whyCN: 流动的水会带走漂浮在它上面的一切。

senses.title: Electric flow
senses.definition: the flow of electric charge through a wire or circuit
senses.definitionCN: 电荷在导线或电路中的流动
senses.example: The current was cut for two hours.
senses.exampleCN: 电流被切断了两个小时。
senses.why: Electricity behaves like water, so it borrowed the same word.
senses.whyCN: 电的行为像水，于是借用了同一个词。

senses.title: Happening now
senses.definition: existing or happening at the present time
senses.definitionCN: 在当前时刻存在或发生的
senses.example: The current price is too high for us.
senses.exampleCN: 目前的价格对我们来说太高了。
senses.why: What is running now is the version that counts today.
senses.whyCN: 此刻正在跑的，才是今天算数的那一版。

intro.en: Current comes from Latin currere, to run, through Old French corant, running.
intro.cn: current 源自拉丁语 currere（跑），经古法语 corant（正在跑的）进入英语。

items.en: Currere meant to run, and water was said to run.
items.cn: currere 意为跑，水也被说成在跑。

items.en: Currens described anything in motion or in use.
items.cn: currens 形容一切在动、在用的东西。

items.en: Corant named the running flow of a stream.
items.cn: corant 指溪流奔涌的水。

items.en: Current entered English for moving water and moving time.
items.cn: current 进入英语，既指流动的水，也指流动的时间。

items.en: Science gave the word to electricity in a wire.
items.cn: 科学把这个词用到了导线里的电上。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the curr- stem, and the meaning group names things that exist at this time.
note.cn: 形近组共享 curr- 词干，近义组列出此时存在的事物。

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with a river pushing a raft and end with the price on today's tag.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从推着木筏的河水开始，落到今天标签上的价格。

normal.en: A current carries what floats, without asking.
normal.cn: 水流带走漂浮的东西，从不事先询问。

normal.en: Electricity borrowed the word because it also runs.
normal.cn: 电借用了这个词，因为电也在跑。

normal.en: The current price is merely the one running at this hour.
normal.cn: 当前价格，不过是这个钟点正在跑的那个价。

normal.en: Current affairs are events still moving, not yet settled.
normal.cn: 时事就是还在流动、尚未落定的事。

normal.en: If it is happening now, it is current.
normal.cn: 如果它此刻正在发生，它就是当前的。

abstract.en: Picture a leaf spinning downstream in a fast channel.
abstract.cn: 想象一片叶子在急流里打着转往下游去。

abstract.en: Picture a wire humming with a flow you cannot see.
abstract.cn: 想象一根导线嗡嗡作响，里面是看不见的流动。

abstract.en: Picture a price tag changed just this morning.
abstract.cn: 想象一张今早才换过的价签。

examples.en: The current swept the small boat toward the rocks.
examples.cn: 水流把小船冲向岩石。

examples.en: Do not touch the wire while the current is on.
examples.cn: 通电时不要碰那根电线。

examples.en: The current plan needs more money.
examples.cn: 当前的计划需要更多钱。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 current 记成「正在跑的」：curr 是跑，-ent 是正在，正在跑的水是水流，正在跑的价是现价。

root: 源自拉丁语 currere（跑、流动），经古法语 corant 进入英语；本义是「正在流动的」，由水的奔流引申为时间的当下，再引申为电流。

sensesIntro.en: From water in motion, to charge in a wire, to the version of things that counts today.
sensesIntro.cn: 从流动的水，到导线里的电荷，再到今天算数的那一版。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a river pushing everything on its surface forward.
core.cn: 核心意象：一条河把水面上的东西不断向前推。

branches.en: The first picture is water moving in one direction.
branches.cn: 第一幅画面，是朝一个方向流动的水。

branches.en: Electric charge moves in the same way, so it takes the same name.
branches.cn: 电荷也这样移动，于是用了同一个名字。

branches.en: Time also runs, so what is running now is current.
branches.cn: 时间也在跑，所以此刻在跑的就是「当前」。

branches.en: Water and electricity share one word for flow.
branches.cn: 水和电共用了一个表示流动的词。

branches.en: A live wire and a live issue are both current.
branches.cn: 带电的导线和当下的议题，都叫 current。

intro.en: Current belongs to the curr- family, where running grows into rivers, wires, and the present hour.
intro.cn: current 属于 curr- 这一族，「跑」长成了河流、导线和眼前的时辰。

latinIntro.en: The Latin currere, to run, stands under current, currency, and recur.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 currere（跑）是 current、currency 与 recur 共同的根。
